label: Experimental weekly estimate (near-real-time data)

attribution.name: NASA FIRMS
attribution.license: NASA open-data reuse with source attribution

limitations: Satellite detections are not counts of fires, ignitions, or burned area.
Clouds, smoke, overpass timing, small fires, and outages can hide detections.
The model was trained on standard-processing detections and is applied to near-real-time detections; the track record measures how well it holds up.

NRT has no type field: nominal/high-confidence detections are retained only outside 375 m great-circle buffers around SP type 1/2 locations observed during 2012-01-20 through 2026-07-31. This static-source mask approximates SP type=0; unseen static sources and non-vegetation detections can remain.

Scheduled forecasts published within 24 hours of issue are marked prospective; publication is normally about six hours into the target week. Inputs exclude those six hours, and scores cover the full seven-day target. Manual or later publications are backfills. Live performance summaries must use prospective=true rows only.
Incomplete target weeks have null labels and are not scored. Weekly estimates and scores can vary substantially; a short track record does not establish reliability.
The strict model is also applied to geographically held-out cells; cell climatology is missing there, and the comparison baseline uses training department climatology.
